newsitem.title: USA: CT Financial's U.S. thrift posts higher Q4.
newsitem.headline: CT Financial's U.S. thrift posts higher Q4.

text.p: First Federal Savings and Loan Association said Tuesday it had net income of $17.2 million in the fourth quarter of 1996, up 7.4 percent from $15.7 million a year ago.

First Federal is a unit of CTUS Inc, U.S. subsidiary of Toronto-based CT Financial Services Inc, which last August announced an agreement to sell First Federal to Marine Midland Bank for $620 million.
Marine Midland, based in Buffalo, N.Y., is a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc.

First Federal said its residential mortgage origination business had record results for the year, and the Nationwide Mortgage Services unit funded $2.45 billion in loans for the year, up 19.2 percent from 1995.
Originations of home equity loans, lines of credit and installment loans totaled a record $131 million in 1996, up 51 percent from 1995.
First Federal said that subject to regulatory approval, the sale to Marine Midland is expected to close February 28.
